entries.title: Hades

primary.why: Hades released on Windows, macOS, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and iOS through Netflix. Windows has the best capture/settings route; the iOS route is no longer a normal current path after removal from Netflix Games.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam or Epic/GOG where owned. Use console versions only for platform comparison and ignore the removed iOS route as a current play option.

entries.title: Hades II

primary.why: Hades II launched in early access on PC and reached version 1.0 in September 2025 on Windows, macOS, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2, with PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S releases in April 2026. The Switch 2 version targets 120 fps in TV mode, but Windows remains the best archive route because it offers the strongest capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through Steam or Epic Games Store. If comparing platform performance, check Nintendo Switch 2 separately for its official 120 fps TV-mode target.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC route with best capture/settings flexibility.
